body: DESIGN CHECKPOINT bd-01M15YX6RWBKPG9H1Z48HDS67J — no code yet. ANSWER 1: benchmark revisit is NOT the interview digression-return relation. Interview TargetInduction is an inference heuristic for episode-cluster membership: explicit ReturnMarker OR lost digression continuity plus target continuity. It can return to the target episode at a never-before-mentioned event, and its lexical cue is evidence. Benchmark revisit is gold route structure under a known source: at unit i, the adjudicated primary source anchor equals its most recent earlier occurrence j, i > j+1, and the immediately previous anchor differs. A,B,A is a revisit; A,A is dwell; A,B,A,A contains one revisit. It is derived from existing GoldUnit.primary, so no new manual gold field. Sharing ClusterContinuity would leak a prediction heuristic into gold and conflate return to an episode with recurrence to the same source event. Exact primary-node identity is deliberate; an ancestor/summary is compression, not the same event. ANSWER 2: RecallSignature.compression is not the metric. Proposed gold-relative pair at UNIT grain, only when view.maxLevel > 0 and gold primary is source-anchored: map-hierarchy closeness = 1 - abs(inferred MAP level - gold primary level)/maxLevel, plus signed bias = (inferred - gold)/maxLevel, positive meaning overcompression/coarser and negative overspecificity. Closeness says magnitude; bias prevents systematic direction from hiding. This complements level-exact rather than duplicating it. Inferred Unranked is Missing(ProviderAbstained); an eligible gold unit with no inferred source level is typed Missing, never Ineligible or zero. No hierarchy means no eligible compression claim, hence AllMissing. REVISIT METRICS: report pair-set recall and precision separately. Gold recurrence pairs are the deterministic last-occurrence pairs above; inferred pairs use MAP source anchors at the same indices. Recall is eligible only on gold pairs; precision only on inferred pairs; same index-pair equality scores route SHAPE, while localization metrics separately score node identity. No gold revisit therefore yields AllMissing with zero eligible support, as required. Precision prevents an alternating-anchor channel from gaming recall. MULTI-STEP SHAPE: add transition-displacement closeness on adjacent source-gold steps: 1 - abs(abs(gold relative-position delta) - abs(inferred relative-position delta)). SourceView.relativePosition is the support-midpoint axis in [0,1], so a five-step reversal differs from a two-step reversal without depending on how densely nodes were annotated. Direction remains a separate metric. First/no-gold-source steps are Ineligible; eligible gold with unavailable inferred support is Missing. TEST LAW: production-path cases through Metrics.observe for A,B,A versus non-revisit, false-positive revisit, no eligible revisit, hand-computed compression closeness/bias, long-versus-short reversal, and Unranked missingness; mutations must alter the published values. NEW BLOCK FOUND IN THE EXISTING METRIC: route:transition-direction compares NodeSummary.discoursePosition, but StorySourceView defines that as rank WITHIN EACH HIERARCHY LEVEL. Comparing a leaf rank to a segment rank is not a common axis and can reverse a mixed-level gold step. relativePosition is the comparable axis already used by RecallSignature. Changing the existing metric silently would violate ADR 0003 definition identity, so I need the chief's ruling: include a renamed text-axis direction metric / receipt revision in this bead, or file it separately. Proposed implementation stays embed-bench-local; no interview dependency or shared public vocabulary.
